2238|5408b909.name: Tog'thar
2238|5408b909.text: Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.

3407|515c0157.name: Sian'dur
3407|515c0157.text: Hey mon, you be needin' to head on over to da $c trainer.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

5909|08ad8d7f.name: Cazul
5909|08ad8d7f.text: Few have the ambition to seek true power. Fewer still have the resolve to do what is necessary to claim it. Power belongs to those who are willing to pay its price, $c.

1068-progress.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-progress.text: The tree spirits wail at the loss of their brethren, $N.  You must destroy the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, or I fear Stonetalon will never be healed.
1068-progress.title: Shredding Machines

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

527-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-progress.text:
As High Executor of Tarren Mill, under the direct command of Varimathras and the Dark Lady, you are subject to follow my command.

Perhaps you take this war with the Alliance lightly?  If such is the case I should behead you right here and now.  Otherwise, travel west to the town of Hillsbrad and wage battle against the humans, as ordered.

Dismissed.
527-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

65601-accept.name: Cazul
65601-accept.text:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, $N, then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
65601-accept.title: Love Hurts

65601-complete.name: Magar
65601-complete.text: Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...
65601-complete.title: Love Hurts

65610-accept.name: Magar
65610-accept.text:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
65610-accept.title: Wish You Were Here

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7826-progress.name: Rashona Straglash
7826-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Orgrimmar for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7826-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

822-progress.name: Brewmaster Drohn
822-progress.text: You working hard at finding those ingredients, $N?
822-progress.title: Chen's Empty Keg

843-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
843-progress.text: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
843-progress.title: Gann's Reclamation

868-progress.name: Korran
868-progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
868-progress.title: Egg Hunt

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

914-progress.name: Nara Wildmane
914-progress.text: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, $N.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
914-progress.title: Leaders of the Fang

91899-complete.name: Dokimi
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Dokimi
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-complete.name: Dokimi
91900-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91900-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-progress.name: Dokimi
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92401-accept.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-accept.text:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401-accept.title: A Frightened Request

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

94237-accept.name: Unknown
94237-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 200 Crafted Solid Shot, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94237-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Crafted Solid Shot

95204-complete.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-complete.text:
<Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>

Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.

Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, $c. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-progress.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-progress.text: What have you got there, $c? A tasty morsel?
95204-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

96988-accept.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988-accept.title: Source of Power

97289-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97289-accept.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289-accept.title: Unending Torment

98093-accept.name: Sulhasa
98093-accept.text:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
98093-accept.title: Field to Clear

98093-complete.name: Sulhasa
98093-complete.text:
Thank you for helping me out, $N. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!

This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.

I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.
98093-complete.title: Field to Clear

98248-complete.name: Dokimi
98248-complete.text:
You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248-complete.title: Shipping Label

98248-progress.name: Dokimi
98248-progress.text: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248-progress.title: Shipping Label
